annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost: about $383 for the Prius c and $437 for the Prius v (RepairPal)

maint.every: Every 10,000 miles or 12 months with 0W-20 synthetic
maint.note: Check the oil level between changes on the Prius v, which can burn oil as it ages.

maint.job: Front brake pads (and rotors if worn)
maint.every: Often 50,000-100,000 miles thanks to regenerative braking
maint.note: YourMechanic averages about $250 for Prius c pads ($81 parts, $168 labor).
The Prius c uses rear drum brakes; the Prius v uses rear discs.
The hybrid drive battery is separate and not included.

maint.job: Engine and inverter coolant drain and refill
maint.every: First at 100,000 miles, then every 50,000 miles
maint.note: The inverter has its own coolant loop; RepairPal puts an inverter coolant service at about $210-270 on the Prius c.
